steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Molar gas volume: The volume occupied by one mole of any gas at room temperature and pressure (RTP). At RTP (20°C and 1 atm), one mole of any gas occupies 24 dm³ (or 24 000 cm³). | Room temperature and pressure (RTP): 20°C and 1 atmosphere pressure. At RTP, equal amounts in moles of any gas occupy the same volume.

steps.body: Higher What volume does 0.5 mol of chlorine gas occupy at RTP? | Higher How many moles are in 120 dm³ of neon gas at RTP? | Higher What mass of CO₂ (M r = 44) occupies 12 dm³ at RTP?
